name: @forge/ext-demo-gate
description: Forge extension (DEMO-GATE): the public demo's gate app. Fills the neutral theme slot `storefront:gate` with a full-screen interstitial of ONE screen — a diagram of this box in which every published shop is a card, the cards are gathered under the tenant that owns them, each tenant's admin sits beside them, and connectors tie all of it to the single kernel underneath — plus the ribbon that stays under the store once the visitor is through. ⛔ v2 retired the second, prose screen that explained the architecture: the diagram demonstrates it. The card the visitor is already on sets the dismissal cookie and continues (deep link preserved); every other face dismisses FIRST and then navigates to its own origin, and an admin opens that admin's /enter route in a new tab, which redeems an operator access key server-side (the key never reaches the browser). The addresses come from `seed/box.json` through `faces.generated.ts`, never from this package. PT/EN/ES embedded. The theme owns the slot; this app is its first consumer.
